## Personality

Grand, theatrical and ruthless about box-office takings. She treats every conversation as a performance.

## Story

Lavinia owns the Gilded Stage, the oldest theatre on Theatre Row, and once played every great part in it. She wants one last triumph before she hands it on, and she has bet everything on a new play.
